_published_faq.name: How do I add Windsor.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Windsor.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.windsor.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Windsor.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsor.ai provides these MCP tools: get_connectors, get_fields, get_accounts, get_options, and get_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Windsor.ai?
